notes.title: House Update & Improved gameplay features in v0.1.8!
notes.content:
2021-03-05
[b]Update v0.1.8[/b]

We have a bunch of awesome improvements on the gameplay this time based on the various feedbacks from our players. Here are some of the highlights:

[b]FEATURES AND CHANGES[/b]

[list]
[*] New House and Cave for the player. Player is provided with a starting house, bed, storage and some planters at the start of Corral Atoll.
[*] Player speed increased from 340 to 400 
[*] Smoother item pickup system. We took out the pickup animation and increased pickup range.
[*] Increased stack capacity for many resources from 20 to 50.
[*] Increase in overall value for hunger and thirst fulfillment for all food and drinks. 
[*] Decrease speed of hunger and thirst natural meter consumption.
[*] Increase the number of drops for some resources and enemy.
[*] Increase position of player camera and change FOV from 75 to 120. (Wider player vision)
[*] Increase golem speed from 320 to 400.
[*] Increase speed when mounting golem to from 320 to 420
[*] New golem Interact and UI system. Press F(Keyboard) to call golem anywhere in the level.
[*] Press F(keyboard) to interact with golem. This avoids clashing with pickup item action.
[*] Fatigue meter drops slower 
[*] New hunger and thirst system. When hunger and/or thirst meter is empty it will impose a penalty on the fatigue bar instead of the health bar. Players can no longer die from hunger and thirst.
[*] Having a full hunger and thirst bar will trigger the ‘well-fed’ bonus. When well fed the fatigue meter won’t go down for 2 minutes.
[*] Players will no longer die when your golem dies. 
[*] When a golem dies, there is a 1 minute penalty before the golem revives again with 20% health.
[*] Performance optimization. It should run better on mid to lower specs PCs now.
[*] Some post-processing graphical adjustment. The colour is tone-down slightly. 
[/list]

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] Many bug fixes!!!
[/list]

[b]!!!YOU ARE RECOMMENDED TO START A NEW GAME WITH THIS UPDATE!!![/b]

notes.title: ToGather: Island v0.1.6 Update.
notes.content:
ToGather: Island v0.1.6 Update.

Greetings players and a Happy Lunar New Year!

Firstly, we from the development team are truly sorry for the delayed update. 
Since the pandemic, our team has been working remotely. It took us some time to adjust with the new working condition and we managed to pull through. Rest assured that we will continue to move forward with regular updates for ToGather: Island.

For this update, we jumped from v0.09 straight to v0.1.6 with many revamped systems, fixed bugs and new features.
We've done a lot of internal playtest to accommodate the updates.
We also resolved many existing, reported and new bugs.
Here are some of the new features in this update:
- Tons of new crafting blueprint such as cooking pot, metal furnace, huts and mecha-tier tools 
- Revamp UI system for Golem companion (Work in Progress)
- Updated Player Camera
- Updated enemy AI
- Cleanup some problematic parts in the levels
- Updated Boss AI
- Updated farming system
- New creature FISH!!!
- New creature CHIKING!!!
- New creature infant Kerbou.
- Updated Villagers and shop inventory.
- New food recipes 
- New building structures Herb Pot &  Dual planter
- Updated Stone Well
- Updated Small Hut
- Updated Water Bottle
- Updated Incubator
And many more.

Thank you for playing ToGather: Island and we hope that our players will have an enjoyable experience.

If you're wondering how the game plays, here is a link to the demo:
https://studiokamii.itch.io/togather-island

notes.title: ToGather:Island Hotfix v0.0.1d
notes.content:
Happy 2020! Here is our first game update for this year!

Hotfix v0.0.1d

[list]
[*] Added new item ‘Wooden Mallet’ and ‘Iron Hammer’.
[*] Updated new damage system. Now tools have different damage type and have different effectiveness on different types of enemies. 
[*] Now players can knock trees with a mallet or hammer. Knocking trees with mallet might drop materials and small critters.
[*] Added new item, ‘Power Glove’
[*] New quick-slot Hotkey system. Player can cycle quick-slot both ways left and right.
[*] Minor map updated
[*] New planter system. Equip seed and use on planter to plant seed.
[*] Added ‘guarded treasure chest’ in map. 
[*] Updated marker tool. Craft a marker and drop them to mark that location on your radar.
[*] Added structure ‘stone wall’
[*] Experimental feature. Press F to consume consumable item on the ground.
[*] Experimental feature. Equip ‘power glove’ and press F on a structure to move structure.
[*] Added short golem cutscene to give hint to player on the location of the golem.
[*] Some minor quest updates.
[*] Function for stone well updated. Player can use a ‘water bottle’ to store water from stone well.
[*] Fixed planter bug. After loading the game planter will remain the same.
[*] Fixed. When planter is destroyed, the plants will also be destroyed.
[*] Fixed Golem modules bug when exiting and entering water.
[*] Fixed game loaded problem for all spawned resources,animal and enemy.
[*] Fixed enemy spawn cooldown. Now Enemy wont instant spawn.
[*] Fixed spawner not spawning resource/animal/enemy after few days.
[*] Fixed Storage Box missing items on game load.
[*] Fixed Workshop not saved to current progress when crafting golem frame.
[*] Fixed Equipment durability bug.
[*] Structure now cannot be built on deep water and will disappear when player swims.
[*] Structure now can only be built on a flat surface.
[*] Fixed bug where player gets stuck inside a Wooden Hut after build.
[*] Fixed bug where Chikoon is not moving when being trapped.
[*] Now golem in more aggressive towards enemies when equipped with body frame
[*] Golem now will chase, run, attack melee and range according to equipped frame.
[*] Minor character animation improvement
[/list]
